message.content:
LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed. Top-left: Causal chain diagram. Top-right: Recorded series (live) line plot. Bottom-left: Float32 bit-pattern strip. Bottom-right: State card HUD.
SERIES: The plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss). However, the data area is completely empty; no lines or data points are visible for any series. A purple circular marker is visible at the top left of the plot area (y=1.0), but it has no trail. The trend is flat/empty as no history is rendered.
TEXT: Step 41 / 59; w = 1.3561949729919434; loss = 0.094453217079863e-05; FPS readout = 8 FPS drawn | step rate 25/s; bits changed = 9 of 32; hex word = 0x3FAD97CC.
BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. There are 9 orange squares (changed this step), located at bit positions approximately 10-14 and 19-22 (1-indexed from the left).
DEFECTS: The "recorded series (live)" panel is a major defect: despite being step 41 of 59, the entire line chart area is blank with no recorded lines or data points. The purple marker is floating at the maximum Y-value without a trail. The "gradient" value in the state card appears as a standalone "1" on its own line, which looks like a formatting misalignment compared to other fields.
VERDICT: FAIL. The primary function of the "recorded series" panel—to show the live history of the optimization—is completely missing, rendering the dashboard incoherent for its intended purpose of observing a real run.
